args: Weekly antigravity-3d failure-to-skill distillation. Run `uv run python -m antigravity3d.runtime.distill_job` in the workspace; it reads .agy3d/telemetry/tool_calls.jsonl and .agy3d/fixes.jsonl and prints the path of a Markdown proposal. Read that proposal. For each recurring failure or recurring fix it lists, draft the smallest change to the antigravity-3d plugin's skills or rules that would have prevented it, as a unified diff in a new file next to the proposal named skill-diff-<date>.md. Do not edit the plugin itself and do not run any other command. Finish with a three-line summary.
description: Every Sunday at 03:43 UTC, clusters the week's tool failures and fixes (distill_job) and drafts skill/rule diffs for human review. It never edits the plugin.
